summary: KE Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching Next Day Disclosure Returns under Hong Kong Listing Rules, reporting multiple share repurchases on the HKEX and NYSE from May 22 to June 10, 2026. Repurchases include both HKD and USD tranches, with prices ranging from approximately HKD 42.57 to HKD 45.01 and USD 5.30 to USD 5.76 per share. Shares are held for cancellation, reflecting an ongoing buyback program. Repurchases reduce outstanding shares, supporting shareholder value. Watch for continuation of buyback pace and impact on liquidity and earnings per share.
